name: car_physics
notes: per frame from frame_update unless frozen/replay: engine torque/drag/resistance; speed; ground contact and gravity; grip/skid; steering; gauges; rev limit (compiled C)

name: replay_clear
notes: zero the ring buffer CS 0ab4:020F (800h words)

name: replay_update
notes: per frame: record ring buffer (state 0), play back (1), wreck animation (2)

name: replay_play_frame
notes: read one recorded frame into the sprite/object tables

name: replay_rec_objects
notes: record visible moving objects (9 words each)

name: controls_poll_far
notes: call 0e12:0751; retf: far stub of controls_poll used by race_input(0/1); the seed name key_dispatch belongs to 0e12:0084

name: key_dispatch
notes: dispatch DS:E08C: 40h-7Fh via CS:0000 table; 81h-8Ah via DS:B6EF when race_state < 2; else controls_poll

name: key_mouse_toggle
notes: F7: mouse steering on/off; asks sensitivity (msg 32h) -> B6CB

name: gear_up
notes: gear++ (not in replay); throttle = 1232 (x2 into 1st); B707 = 1

name: gear_up_gate
notes: key A / Enter+Up; CERV range jump

name: gear_down
notes: gear-- (not in replay); into R while rolling > 14h damages R (sfx 11); throttle = 1234 (x2 into R)

name: gear_down_gate
notes: key Z / Enter+Down; CERV range jump

name: key_chase_view
notes: F5 CHASE CAR VIEW: toggle ext_view DS:948B (saves/restores ground state); during a crash replay: life_lost(1)

name: key_wipers
notes: W: DS:BC7B ^= 1 (not in replay; Likely wipers)

name: key_headlights
notes: H: DS:B6D8 ^= 1 (not in replay; Likely headlights)

name: key_detail
notes: F2: detail B6DD cycle 0-2; msg 1Bh+; detail_apply

name: detail_apply
notes: view distance B6DE/E0/E2 and vegetation mask BA56 by detail; strips traffic flags by skill

name: life_lost
notes: lives message; F10 replay request; next life (race_state 2) or game over (3)

name: key_instant_replay
notes: F10: replay_start (0e12:4c51); during a replay: B6D5 = 1 and msg 19h

name: key_replay_pause
notes: F9 (during a replay): B6D4 ^= 1; prints Paused

name: key_steer_sensitivity
notes: F3: msg 31h with current DS:09C2 digit

name: key_radio
notes: M: radio station B6CC cycle 0-2 via 01f4:1d22; msg 22h/27h/28h

name: key_debug_night
notes: N (dead: needs DS:B6EA): toggle 95C7 and sky colours

name: key_debug_flip
notes: O while frozen: B6D0 ^= 1 (used only by unreached 0e12:06c3)

name: debug_projection
notes: unreached debug vertex projection using B6CE/B6D0

name: controls_poll
notes: reads key/joystick/mouse bits; brake; throttle release; shift keys; steering; replay camera keys

name: mouse_controls
notes: mouse x -> steer_wheel; buttons/y -> gas/brake bits

name: auto_shift
notes: per frame: automatic up/down shifts (DS:0095) and CERV in-range shifts

name: steer_throttle
notes: throttle +-2; brake bit; keyboard steering ramp; analog joystick steering

name: race_clock_hud
notes: race clock (5 frames = 1 s) then clock_draw compass_draw radar_detector

name: compass_draw
notes: compass tape; dead debug readout of B70E (hud)

name: radar_detector
notes: bars from B710>>4; blink 8 frames; beep sfx 0Eh every 16 frames

name: overrev_damage
notes: every 4th rev-limit event (skill >= 3): engine (20h) or current gear damage

name: landing_damage
notes: hard landing (skill >= 3): 1/32 gear damage else random_damage

name: random_damage
notes: 1/8 suspension (4) or brakes (8) with sfx 12; 1/64 alignment (msg 2Eh); no skill check when called by 33f7/4631

name: crash_start
notes: latch crashed B78D; music stop; shake 10h; crash_object = object whose face range holds BAA9

name: screen_shake_step
notes: per frame: DS:947C countdown -> display offset from CS table 0e12:0F81

name: bounce_back
notes: restore position from 3 frames ago; shake = 4

name: vec_angle
notes: atan2 via CS 0e12:12F6/16F8; also returns CX min DX max

name: grip_yaw_limit
notes: max course change per frame (16-bit overflow for CERV)

name: life_reset
notes: per-life reset; respawn at road_mem[2] after F6 or a crash; immunity 32h

name: sprite_collisions
notes: sprite classes 20h-E0h (knock over, solid, splat, go back, wrong way)

name: scene_update
notes: render root; runs traffic, gate, near_face_collisions, lights, police

name: near_face_collisions
notes: faces within depth 60h: type 1 solid, 2 vehicles, 18h-1Bh signs, 1Ah barriers

name: draw_face_dispatch
notes: render dispatcher (objects spec name confirmed over face_under_car); ground query label 3d28 inside the triangle path

name: barrier_knockdown
notes: flatten a type-1Ah barrier; sfx 4; shake 5; bump 3

name: object_face_hit
notes: knock over sign/cone/bird: model swap; sfx 5/12h; random_damage

name: replay_start
notes: replay / crash camera: replay_state 1, ext_view 1, end marker (index & 7FFh bug)

name: obj_emit_parked
notes: parked 1000h objects; lightning flash + thunder sfx 9 when rain >= 6

name: traffic_update
notes: timers; per object vehicle_follow_lane + movement; visibility; emit

name: vehicle_follow_lane
notes: waypoints, stops at lights/signs/crossing, branches, opponent scripts, overtaking (conflict: traffic_follow_path)

name: lane_list_for_cell
notes: P.BIN list of the cell; 946A rotation; 946D count (conflict: path_tile_lookup)

name: crossing_gate_update
notes: train near gate -> BCD8 gate position; bells sfx 7/8

name: police_update
notes: radar level B710; chase at speed >= 48; pull-over 30 frames; ticket +20 s; siren sfx 14h/94h

name: police_end_chases
notes: clear 4000h/40h on police models 11h/30h; pullover count 0

name: opponent_final_time
notes: estimate unfinished opponent time; ticket penalties (Likely)

name: tri_height_at_viewpoint
notes: height of the triangle at the probe point 94A1/94A3

name: ground_slope_update
notes: BCDC roll code; BCDD pitch error clamp 18h; BA85 fallback

name: camera_pos_update
notes: camera X/Z and probe point 94A1/94A3; sun sprite 8; crash camera target

name: route_index
notes: 0-2 set by 70cd from route tiles 95C9 when the cell is unchanged

name: offroad_frames
notes: frames since last on road (9 bits); 40h -> msg 0Ch and F6 allowed

name: accel
notes: net force / speed change of the frame

name: rpm_inertia
notes: engine inertia term added to the drive force

name: replay_end
notes: end of the last recorded frame

name: cam_moved
notes: camera moved by hand: no auto-follow

name: kbd_bits
notes: ISR direction bits: 1 up 2 down 4 left 8 right 10h Enter 20h space

name: damage
notes: bits 0/1 alignment; 2 suspension; 3 brakes; 5 engine; 8+gear gear broken

name: pending_msg
notes: message shown at the start of the next frame

name: ext_view
notes: chase view (F5) or replay/crash camera: physics traffic clock and collisions stop; cursor keys move the camera

name: leg_gravity
notes: leg file +002: 600; gravity 900/frame; snap distance 2400; grip scale

name: wind_dir
notes: leg file +045 read as word: wind direction

name: debug_keys
notes: 0 in the exe and never written: S/T/N keys dead

name: prev_bits
notes: control bits of the previous poll

name: throttle_released
notes: Up released -> car_physics searches the cruise throttle

name: clock_running
notes: set by any gear shift and on resume; clock and traffic run only while set; the crash immunity only counts down while set

name: frame_ticks
notes: timer ticks the previous frame took (race_run); scales the steering rate

name: road_mem
notes: last 3 road positions (x z y heading) every other frame

name: ground_y
notes: height of the ground under the car (collision code)

name: face_type_x8
notes: w3 hi & F8h of the face being drawn

name: surface
notes: ground face type; FFh none; 1Fh finish

name: bump_frames
notes: random vertical bumps after a hit

name: crash_flag
notes: cleared each frame; set by hard landing/water/solid hits -> crash_start

name: crash_face
notes: FFFFh each frame; face index of a hit

name: invulnerable
notes: frames of no-crash after a restart; counts down on water or gear change

name: flash_msg
notes: message posted when the sky flash ends

name: uturn_obj
notes: 2i of the police car to U-turn

name: y_before
notes: pos_y at the start of the frame
